question: Why does Aparṇā acknowledge that teachings were given to her by Śaṅkara?
premises: Śaṅkara is all-knowing and addressed as lord
The teachings were given out of compassion
inference: Aparṇā acknowledges that the all-knowing lord compassionately told her the teachings.
plain_english: O Lord, all these things were told to me out of compassion by you, the all-knowing one.
